content:
#1 For some reason I find myself unable to edit pages in my personal web.

I know to go to “show” (not published) mode, where I am prompted to enter my password. After I do, my home page appears to be editable, but when I click on a specific page listed on the home page, I get sent to the article but with no edit button at the bottom of the page.

Any ideas?
subject: unable to edit my web pages

content: #2 Ah, never mind – I figured it out. Clicking on an article pops one back into published mode; I had to go into show mode again (although, I thought I had eliminated that possibility before).
subject: unable to edit my web pages
